main_text.p: מוּל Circumcidi. Niphal נִמּוֹל Idem. Pihel מוֹלֵל Succidere, Exscindere. Hiphil הֵמִיל idem. Hithpahel הִתְמוֹלֵל Incîdi.
אֶלמוּל, מוּל מוּל לְמוּאָל, Coram, Contra: מִפּוּל E regione, Ex adverso.
מוּר Hiphil הֵמִיר Mutare, Commutare. Niphal נָמוּר Mutari.
מוּשׁ Recedere, Discedere, Dimoveri: Semel transitive, Amovere: item, Palpare, Contrectare. Hiphil הֵמִישׁ Palpare facere: Item, Recedere.
מוּת Mori. Pihel מוֹתֵת. Hiphil הֵמִית Mori fecit, Interfecit, Occidit, Morte affecit. Hophal הוּמַת Interfici, Morte affici.
מָוֶת m. Mors: cū He paragogico מָוְתָה : in Regimine gimine

page.notes: Hebrew and Latin lines are reproduced as far as legible; the edges are stained and several vowel points are doubtful. Running head is the Hebrew catchword מוּ. Printed "gimine" is the continuation of "Regimine" at the foot.
